title: Normal
summary: NOR'MAL, adjective [Latin a square, a rule.] 1. According to a square or rule; perpendicular; forming a right angle. 2. According to a rule or principle. 3. Relating to rudiments or elements; teaching

inlines.v: NOR'MAL, adjective [Latin a square, a rule.] 1. According to a square or rule; perpendicular; forming a right angle. 2. According to a rule or principle. 3. Relating to rudiments or elements; teaching rudiments or first principles; as normal schools in France.
